quote: the mean of each CP is concatenated to make final feature vector
note: Whole CC-CV charge V/I/T (NASA, starts after full discharge) reduced to 10 averaged points per channel; no explicit CC time/charge -> summary of full curve. Current-cycle capacity estimation; LOBO and 85/15 both reported.

quote: F6 is the sample entropy of discharging voltage
note: Entropy statistic of the discharge voltage series; whole discharge implied, window not stated.

quote: Tcc represents for the CC charging time ... Ratio = Tcc/(Tcc+Tcv)
note: Input is the dimensionless ratio Tcc/(Tcc+Tcv), not absolute CC time; capacity-linked but not Q/I -> weak.

quote: average charging current, average charging voltage, average discharge current and average discharge voltage
note: Mean V/I over whole discharge = summary statistic.

quote: average charging current, average charging voltage, average discharge current and average discharge voltage
note: Mean V/I over whole CC-CV charge; weakly capacity-linked (mean I = Q/t) but not capacity-equivalent.

quote: uses the voltage distribution and capacity changes in the extracted battery discharge curve
note: Full discharge sample (4000x1 vector) incl. capacity changes; under CC discharge the curve length/endpoint encodes Q. Per-sample min-max (not whole-life). Exact channel composition of the 4000 vector not spelled out; Fig. 8 shows charge curves (minor inconsistency). Test cells disjoint.

quote: constant current charging time, constant voltage charging time ... constant current charging time ratio
note: HF2 = absolute CC charging time (NASA after full discharge; CALCE CS2-35/37 same protocol); used as model input (HF3 dropped for B0018 only).

quote: the SampEn of the discharge voltage for each discharge cycle
note: Entropy of whole discharge voltage series; other input is discharge cutoff (minimum) voltage. Single cell, chronological 90/10.

quote: the average discharge voltage is taken as HI11
note: Mean discharge voltage (and isochronous drop HI10, partial window) -> weak. HI11 not among eliminated HI2/3/6/15.

quote: the charging energy is used as an indicator ... denoted as HI16
note: HI16 total charging energy of CC-CV charge from discharged NASA state (~Q*V); also HI9 area under CC voltage curve (~V*t_cc). Both retained after r>=0.75 filter.

quote: Min-max normalization is applied to all data
note: 'All data' most plausibly means all features; text does not say the scaler is per-cell or fitted on whole life incl. test cycles. Insufficient evidence for future-info leakage.

quote: SVD was applied to both voltage and temperature data for each discharge cycle
note: Singular values FV7/FV8 of whole-discharge V/T data, selected (FV6-11). Matrix construction not described; a raw-length singular value would scale with sqrt(duration) (possible strong link, inference only). Other selected features partial-window (TVC 3.5-3.9 V).

quote: The ICA curves during charging and discharging ... used as one of the input features
note: STRENGTH DOWNGRADED strong->weak: raw traces are Fourier-resampled to equal length (removes discharge-duration information); how IC curves are fed (with V axis, area) not described, so capacity-equivalence not established. 'ICA' also mislabelled as independent component analysis.

quote: terminal voltage, temperature, and current throughout the entire charging process
note: Whole-charge V/I/T used but Fourier-resampled to fixed length (absolute CC time lost); charge IC representation unspecified -> weak. Split not described.

quote: g3 is set to a time interval ... reduced from 3.7 V to 2.7 V
note: Window ends at B0005 cutoff (2.7 V) and near end-of-discharge for B6/B7; covers most of CC discharge -> ~Q/I. g3 alone forms final formula (Eq. 8).

quote: g1 ... CC charging voltage 2.7 V rising to 4.2 V
note: Full CC charge time from discharged state; g1 among most frequent features in GP formulas.

quote: duration required for the voltage to reach the charging cutoff value of 4.2 V
note: HF1 CC charge time (NASA); retained (PCC>0.75).

quote: represent the lowest and maximum values in each HF curve accordingly
note: HF curve = per-battery feature trajectory over cycles; normalization at feature-extraction stage before 50-70% within-cell split, so min/max include test cycles. Per-cell whole-life scope is inferred from text, not stated verbatim.

quote: three health features, namely, the constant-current charging time (CCCT)
note: CCCT direct input (NASA/CALCE/Oxford CC charge after discharge); ICAV (mean IC over whole charge ~ dQ/dV area) also capacity-linked.

quote: the duration of the CC stage (HF1) is selected as a key feature
note: HF1 is one of 25 candidates; EWOA wrapper selection output not reported (Fig. 5 shows only 'one instance'). Would be strong if selected.

quote: chosen as the first health feature (HF1)
note: CC charge duration on CALCE CS2_35-38 (CC charge after CC discharge to 2.7 V); HF1-HF6 are final inputs.

quote: the lowest point in time-of-discharge voltage H1, average discharge time H2
note: H1 = time at which CC discharge voltage reaches its minimum (cutoff) = Q/I; H1-H3 final inputs; cell held out.

quote: The charging capacity (F3) is calculated based on Coulomb counting
note: Same-cycle full charge capacity (charge follows full discharge on NASA/CALCE) as input -> strong P1.

quote: the proportion of constant current charging time (F1)
note: F1 is a ratio of CC time (range 0-1), not absolute CC time -> weak (the strong proxy here is F3/P1).

quote: Constant Current Charging Time (CCCT)
note: CCCT on CALCE CS2 (CC charge after full discharge); final input with IR, CVCT.

quote: minimum and maximum values of that feature across all cycles of a given battery
note: Per-battery whole-life min-max incl. held-out test battery (LOO), despite 'strict independence' claim.
